specs.value: Right: induction hotends; left: standard hotends
specs.quote: Right hotends (Induction hotends) : 4 × 0.4 mm hardened steel induction hotends … Left hotends (Standard hotends): 2 × 0.4 mm hardened steel standard hotends
specs.note: FAQ prose, so unverified; neither the H2C spec sheet nor the store table has a "Hotend" row. The value keeps the side names of FAQ 1: "Right hotends (Induction hotends)", "Left hotends (Standard hotends)". Skeptic: was "Right: induction hotends (hardened steel); left: standard hotends (hardened steel)" with the condition "Hotends included with the H2C AMS Combo and Laser Full Combo". FAQ 1 states hardened steel only for the 4 × 0.4 mm induction and 2 × 0.4 mm standard hotends (the 0.2 mm and 0.6 mm induction hotends have no material there), and the Vortek Ultimate Bundle adds a 0.2 mm stainless steel left nozzle, so the material is dropped; the side layout holds for every version (the bundle description also puts the induction nozzle on the RHS and the others on the LHS).
